ev.q: Source: Food and Drug Administration. Highlights of prescribing information.
HPV4 had high efficacy for prevention of genital warts among 4,055 males aged 16 through 26 years.
ACIP recommends routine vaccination of males aged 11 or 12 years with HPV4
The evidence for HPV4 vaccination of males was evaluated using Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) methods

methods_quotes.q: The evidence for HPV4 vaccination of males was evaluated using Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) methods
Data on HPV4 for males were reviewed according to GRADE methods
Per protocol population included males who received all 3 vaccine doses
